title: Reusable architectural state and memory in Axeyum
statement: Implement reusable finite register files, byte-addressed memory, state observations, normal and trapped outcomes, and load/store laws on Axeyum's word foundation. The implementation must distinguish book definitions from solver encodings and support positive and negative controls.
notes: The 2026-08-27 Axeyum audit found a planned Memory Model Library in docs/sibling-projects.md but no current reusable ISA state or memory implementation.
